Looping in a quick ops note from finance side — tagging here so procurement has what they need: 

- Standard Redwood payment terms: Net-30 from invoice receipt. We can entertain Net-45 with business justification but need approvals.
- For PO/invoice: procurement should include PO number on the invoice PDF or in the invoice metadata. Without a PO number, AP holds payment.
- Remittance options: ACH (preferred) or wire. If AP requests a different remit address for US vs international, we will provide both in the vendor packet.

I attached our standard invoice template to help procurement prefill and share with AP: standard_invoice_template.xlsx

Cc'ing Sanjay so procurement has the template and knows the PO requirement. Mina — if you prefill the Greenfield form, please include the bank details and indicate ACH as preferred.
